body: Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) enables large language models (LLMs) to learn from multi-turn interactions with verifiable outcomes. Textual skills can improve exploration by distilling prior interactions into reusable guidance. However, existing skill-based RL approaches often either assume skill injection is beneficial or rely on indirect feedback or rollout-intensive evaluation to assess its utility. Our pilot studies show that rollout-based utility estimation for skill credit assignment is costly and unstable under limited sampling, while skill benefits vary across candidates and depend on the current policy's competence on each query. To address these challenges, we introduce SkillScaffold, a policy-adaptive training scaffold that combines low-cost skill-utility estimation with selective skill injection. By reusing outcome-verified training trajectories, SkillScaffold generates candidate skills and estimates their utility through outcome-aware likelihood comparisons, without candidate-specific environment rollouts. The resulting utility guides whether and which skill to inject, retaining skill-free execution when no candidate is estimated to help. Joint training enables the Generator to produce skills tailored to the evolving Executor. Scaffolded RL encourages skill internalization for skill-free inference. Experiments on ALFWorld, WebShop, ScienceWorld, and τ2-Bench demonstrate gains over strong agentic-RL and skill-based RL baselines across both short- and long-horizon tasks. Ablations and further analyses support the importance of utility-based selection and abstention. Our code is available at https://github.com/Vaidurya00/SkillScaffold.
summaryZh: 针对智能体强化学习中技能收益估计成本高昂且不稳定的痛点，SkillScaffold提出低成本的技能效用估计与选择性注入机制。该方案复用带验证结果的训练轨迹，通过似然对比评估技能价值并决定是否注入，不仅在ALFWorld、ScienceWorld等基准上超越强基线，还促使策略将技能内化以实现免技能的高效推理。

aiReview.reasonZh: 提出了无需高成本采样采样的自适应技能归因与选择性注入框架，提升了强化学习智能体长程任务表现。

glossary.explanationZh: 智能体强化学习，让大模型通过与外部环境多轮交互并依据结果反馈进行策略优化的技术。
技能信用归因，评估特定经验或技能对最终任务成功所作贡献程度的过程。
基于环境采样的效用估计，通过多次在模拟环境中实际运行推演来衡量候选技能效果的方法。
选择性技能注入，仅在判定候选技能确有收益时将其引入上下文指导推理的机制。
